entries.headline: Yordan Alvarez stayed in the yard
entries.story: Yordan Alvarez went 1-for-4 with 1 RBI against Seth Johnson and the Athletics. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber came close
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 2-for-4 with 1 BB and 2 RBI against Nick Martinez and the Tampa Bay Rays. Closest call was a double in the 2nd: "Kyle Schwarber doubles (20) on a sharp line drive to right fielder Jonny DeLuca. J.T. Realmuto scores. Trea Turner scores." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Kazuma Okamoto stayed in the yard
